University of Oulu: Mandatory SAT >= 1200 total & >= 600 Math; docs due 2027-01-28 (Dec 2026 SAT is final sitting).
Kyushu University IUPE: Mandatory standardized test (SAT Math >= 710 in 2026 guide — verify 2027 PDF); online reg 2026-12-07 to 2026-12-11.
UNSW Sydney: SAT >= 1260 allows full offer ahead of final CBSE results.
Penn State: SAT EBRW >= 570 exempts IELTS/TOEFL; test-optional for admission.
UMich & UW-Madison: Test-optional for Fall 2027; UMich superscores, UW-Madison does not.
